name: Single-Database Rewards Are Hackable: Counterfactual Execution for Trustworthy Text-to-SQL RL
title: Single-Database Rewards Are Hackable: Counterfactual Execution for Trustworthy Text-to-SQL RL
summary: A counterfactual-database reward for reinforcement learning text-to-SQL agents reduces full payment to buggy queries and reward hacks, though training with its mean form did not improve in-domain accuracy in a controlled GRPO comparison.
